## Summary
What changed, and why?

## Related issue
Closes #

## Change type
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Security or privacy

## Verification
- [ ] Tests run (include commands and outcomes)
- [ ] Lint/build checks run where applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] UI checked for responsive and accessible behavior where applicable

## Security, privacy, and data
Describe new permissions, external services, data collection, migrations, or risk changes. State “No change” if none.

## Deployment and rollback
Mention required configuration, migrations, deployment steps, and rollback approach.

## Screenshots or output
Add evidence if relevant.

## Reviewer notes
Known limitations, trade-offs, and follow-up work.
